decisions.reason: The chart visualization plugin fits directly into the firm's established web-GIS offering and the multiple early releases indicate active investment rather than withdrawal risk.
Although marketed less prominently, the hierarchical search plugin is close to the firm's core map application business and is likely to be retained as a useful add-on feature.
The mobile layer control component supports a clear customer need in mobile map usability and was highlighted prominently, which points to continued support.
As the firm's flagship platform and a focus of its strategic direction, this GIS solution platform is very unlikely to be taken off the market.
Mobile field data capture is a strong adjacent fit with integrated enterprise geospatial solutions and is likely to remain part of the portfolio.
The search extension complements the firm's existing web map app stack and is likely to be kept as part of a broader modular product family.
